Dream
Imagine the possibilities!
During the meeting, dream Crewmates into the roles you desire.
Dream Crewmates into the roles you desire.

The Dreamer is a Crewmate Power role that can temporarily change the roles of other players for one round. During the meeting, they can choose a target player and a role they would like them to be. The target player will turn into that role for one round if they are a Crewmate and the role is available.
Dream

Dream of a player to change their role. If they are a Crewmate and the role chosen is currently available, the target will become that new role. If the target is not a Crewmate, the dream will fail and nothing will happen.

Chameleon
Blend in with the shadows!
Camouflage to sneakily get around and gather info!
Use your Camouflage ability to turn invisible and gather information.

The Chameleon is a Crewmate Investigative role that can use their ability to temporarily turn invisible to all other players. During the time that they are invisible, the Chameleon will get a speed boost, and if settings allow, the ability to vent. Idea by mystic_haze2
